notes: Odoo's external API is RPC method dispatch, not REST: the adaptor (via odoo-await) authenticates and then routes every one of its six operations — create, read, update, deleteRecord, searchRecord, searchReadRecord — through a single execute_kw call. This document models Odoo's JSON-RPC equivalents of that transport (POST /web/session/authenticate and POST /jsonrpc), which is the whole externally reachable surface: verified against ast.json, all 6 operations funnel through callObject. BEST-EFFORT rather than complete because execute_kw dispatches by method name at runtime — the set of callable model methods is open-ended and cannot be enumerated in OpenAPI — and because the underlying transport is really XML-RPC (POST /xmlrpc/2/common and /xmlrpc/2/object, text/xml), which OpenAPI cannot describe at all. Request/response schemas are therefore models of the JSON-RPC envelope, not a captured vendor spec.
